item.title: Here’s How to Watch the 2026 ‘Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks’ Live Online for Free
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Happy 4th of July! Welcome to our special episode, where we're celebrating the United States' 250th anniversary. I'm your host, and I'm excited to share with you the details of this year's Macy's 4th of July Fireworks, hosted by the one and only Terry Crews!
[Upbeat music continues]
Host: "This year's event features an epic fireworks display and laser light show along the East River and Brooklyn Bridge in New York City, as well as the Hudson River in New Jersey. And, if that's not enough, you'll get to enjoy live music performances from some of the biggest names in music, including Post Malone, Noah Kahan, Shaboozey, Salt-N-Pepa, Bebe Rexha, Blake Shelton, and many more!
[Short music break]
Host: "So, how can you watch this incredible event? The 50th annual Macy's 4th of July Fireworks airs on NBC and streams on Peacock on July 4th at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT. And, if you want to catch the fireworks display, tune in around 9:25 p.m. ET/6:25 p.m. PT.
[Short music break]
Host: "If you don't have access to NBC, don't worry! You can still watch the event online for free with a subscription to services like DirecTV, Fubo, or Hulu + Live TV. And, with some of these services, you can even get a free trial, so you can try before you commit.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's special episode. We hope you have a fantastic 4th of July celebration, and we'll catch you on the next one!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
